title: Prototype local Agent Command Gateway
scope: Implement an opt-in loopback-only Dashboard command gateway for registered existing Codex tasks. Support visible new turns, active-turn steering, and interruption with explicit preview, idempotency, provider acknowledgement, truthful delivery state, and no automatic retry.
Exclude remote control, mobile control, cross-host dispatch, new Codex task creation, background task spawning, automatic model switching, and any release or publication.
acceptance_criteria: The command gateway is disabled by default and unavailable unless the loopback Codex provider is ready and the target is a registered eligible task.
New-turn, steer, and interrupt requests enforce target and expected-state checks, idempotency, bounded input, and explicit user confirmation without exposing provider credentials.
The Dashboard distinguishes submitted, provider-accepted, turn-started, completed, failed, interrupted, and delivery-unknown states and never equates HTTP success with Agent execution.
Deterministic tests cover success, duplicate submission, disconnect, stale turn, provider rejection, unknown delivery, and forbidden remote or unregistered targets; full verification passes.
Runtime visual review verifies the local Dashboard flow; real Codex execution remains a separately identified validation boundary if no safe disposable registered task is authorized.
